title: Colorado PUC Decision C26-0054-I: Interim Commission Decision Scheduling Public Comment Hearing and Commissioners’ Information Meeting
summary: Interim Commission Decision Scheduling Public Comment Hearing and Commissioners’ Information Meeting
text:
Decision No. C26-0054-I 
BEFORE THE PUBLIC UTILITIES COMMISSION OF THE STATE OF COLORADO 
PROCEEDING NO. 26M-0037E 
IN THE MATTER OF THE COMMISSION'S REVIEW OF WILDFIRE MITIGATION 
PLANNING AND PUBLIC SAFETY POWER SHUTOFF PROCEDURES. 
INTERIM COMMISSION DECISION SCHEDULING 
PUBLIC COMMENT HEARING AND COMMISSIONERS’ 
INFORMATION MEETING 
Issued Date: 
January 26, 2026 
Adopted Date: January 14, 2026 

I. 
BY THE COMMISSION 
A. 
Statement 
1. 
By this Decision the Commission schedules a public comment hearing to be held 
on January 28, 2026, from 4:00 p.m. to 6 p.m. and a Commissioners’ Information Meeting to be 
held on February 2, 2026, from 1 p.m. to 4 p.m. 
B. 
Background, Findings, and Conclusion 
2. 
By Decision No. C26-0012, the Commission opened this miscellaneous docket to 
serve as a pre-rulemaking in support of Wildfire Mitigation Planning and Public Safety Power 
Shutoff (“PSPS”) rules and to serve as a repository for public comments already received regarding 
the recent Public Service Company of Colorado (“Public Service”) PSPS events and for 
Commissioner Information Meetings and Public Comment Hearings. Through that decision, the 
Commission directed Commission Staff to, among other things, schedule both a public comment 
Colorado PUC E-Filings System

Before the Public Utilities Commission of the State of Colorado 
Decision No. C26-0054-I 
PROCEEDING NO. 26M-0037E 

2 
hearing and a Commissioner’s Information Meeting regarding the Public Service PSPS events that 
took place on December 17 and 19, 2025. 
3. 
We now schedule a remote public comment hearing to be held on January 28, 2026, 
from 4:00 p.m. to no later than 6:00 p.m. The public comment hearing is intended to give the 
Commission an opportunity to hear directly from those impacted by the December 2025 
Public Service PSPS events including impacted customers, businesses, and community members. 
4. 
Staff will provide information about registering to provide public comments on the 
Commission’s public calendar of events at: 
https://puc.colorado.gov/puccalendar 
5. 
When providing public comments, commenters should give their full name, and 
spell it, before they give their comments. In general, commenters will be called to speak in the 
order in which they sign up. The presiding officer may adopt procedures and time limits for 
comments as necessary to ensure that all members of the public have opportunity to comment, and 
the transcribed record is clear and understandable. Typical time limits range from one to three 
minutes for each commenter. To ensure the hearing time is used efficiently, commenters are 
requested to avoid repetitive comments that re-state filed written comments or repeat oral 
comments already provided at hearing. 
6. 
Interested persons who do not wish to provide comments but wish to observe can 
review virtual public comment hearings on the Commission’s YouTube channel: 
https://www.youtube.com/@COPublicUtilitiesCommission/ 
7. 
Public comments can be filed at any time in the Proceeding and will be afforded 
the same weight as oral comments. Public comments can be submitted as follows: 

Before the Public Utilities Commission of the State of Colorado

3 
• Submitting written comments through the Commission’s Electronic Filing 
System (E-Filings) at: https://www.dora.state.co.us/pls/efi/EFI.homepage. 
• Submitting written comments using the Commission’s online form1 or through 
email at: dora_puc_website@state.co.us. These comments will be posted in 
E-Filings for this Proceeding. 
• Mailing comments to the Commission’s offices at: Colorado Public Utilities 
Commission, 1560 Broadway, Suite 250, Denver, CO 80202. 
• Calling (303) 869-3490 to leave oral comments (English and Spanish options). 
8. 
Please include “Proceeding No. 26M-0037E” in comments. The Commission 
prefers submission of comments through its online form for efficiency. 
9. 
We also schedule a Commissioners’ Information Meeting (“CIM”) to be held on 
February 2, 2026, from 1:00 p.m. to no later than 4:00 p.m. The purpose of the CIM is to give the 
Commission the opportunity to hear from utilities, county-level and other governmental entities, 
and other impacted entities such as Public Service wholesale and transmission customers. 
10. 
The CIM will be conducted using the Zoom platform. Staff will distribute the link 
and meeting ID or access code to presenters and parties by email approximately one week before 
the CIM. Parties and participants are prohibited from distributing that information to anyone not 
participating in the CIM. While the CIM will be limited to invited presenters and parties, it will be 
streamed and recorded on the Commission’s YouTube channel: 
https://www.youtube.com/@COPublicUtilitiesCommission/ 
II. 
ORDER 
A. 
It Is Ordered That:
